entry.p: If you want to speed up temporarily without altering the set speed while Smart Cruise Control is operating, depress the accelerator pedal. While the accelerator pedal is depressed, the set speed, distance level and target distance will blink on the cluster.
However, if the accelerator pedal is depressed insufficiently, the vehicle may decelerate.

note.p: Be careful when accelerating temporarily, because the speed and distance is not controlled automatically even if there is a vehicle in front of you.
